header.lead: JCN runs on the kindness of our community. There’s a place for everyone.

items.title: Volunteer
items.text: Lend a hand, a heart, or a few hours.

items.title: Donate
items.text: Every gift reaches a family facing serious illness — through meals, care, respite or a home at Tikva House.

blocks.markdown:
## Where your gift goes

- Shabbos meals and holiday packages for families at home and in the hospital
- Nursing and respite care when insurance isn’t enough
- Tutoring, camp, birthdays and outings for children
- Kosher hospitality at Tikva House for families traveling for treatment
